PART II

PART II.
REGISTRATION

§11-11 Registration. A person who
registers as required by law shall be entitled to vote at any election provided
that the person shall have attained the age of eighteen at the time of that
election. The county clerk shall be responsible for voter registration in the
respective counties and the keeping of the general register and precinct lists
within the county. [L 1970, c 26, pt of §2; am L 1976, c 106, §1(1); gen ch
1985]
